subject: Film & Cinema
title: Temp Tracks and the Creativity Problem
description: A 60-second lesson on Temp Tracks and the Creativity Problem.

hook.text: Directors use existing music as placeholders during editing. Then they can't let go.

buildup.text: Temp tracks guide the composer's work — but they also limit imagination.

discovery.text: 2001: A Space Odyssey used its temp track — Strauss waltzes — as the final score.

twist.text: Many composers hate temp tracks because directors want copies, not original music.

climax.text: The temp track habit makes many blockbuster scores sound interchangeable.

punchline.text: Placeholder music often becomes the permanent prison.

quiz.question: What is a temp track in filmmaking?
options: Existing music used as a placeholder during editing
